title_en: Property tax relief for disabled veterans in {state}
title_es: Alivio del impuesto a la propiedad para veteranos discapacitados en {state_es}
search_intent_en: {state} property tax exemption for disabled veterans

facts.claim_en: California has two levels of the Disabled Veterans' Exemption.
facts.claim_es: California tiene dos niveles de la exención para veteranos discapacitados.
facts.quote: There are two levels of the Disabled Veterans' Exemption:

facts.claim_en: In California, an unmarried surviving spouse of a qualified veteran may also claim the exemption.
facts.claim_es: En California, el cónyuge sobreviviente no casado de un veterano que califica también puede solicitar la exención.
facts.quote: An unmarried surviving spouse of a qualified veteran may also claim the exemption.

facts.claim_en: California's Board of Equalization says a qualifying claimant should claim the Disabled Veterans' Exemption instead of the Veterans' Exemption or the Homeowners' Exemption.
facts.claim_es: La Junta de Igualación de California indica que quien califique debe solicitar la exención para veteranos discapacitados en lugar de la exención para veteranos o la de propietarios.
facts.quote: Thus, if a claimant qualifies, the Disabled Veterans' Exemption should be claimed on the property instead of either of those two exemptions.

facts.claim_en: In Colorado, qualified disabled veterans and Gold Star spouses may receive a 50% property tax exemption on the first $200,000 of their home's value.
facts.claim_es: En Colorado, los veteranos discapacitados que califican y los cónyuges Gold Star pueden recibir una exención del 50% del impuesto a la propiedad sobre los primeros $200,000 del valor de su vivienda.
facts.source_name: Colorado Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
facts.quote: Qualified Disabled Veterans and Gold Star Spouses may receive a 50% property tax exemption on the first $200,000 of their home's value.

facts.claim_en: The Colorado exemption applies only to the primary residence.
facts.claim_es: La exención de Colorado se aplica solo a la residencia principal.
facts.source_name: Colorado Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
facts.quote: This exemption is applicable only to their primary residence.

facts.claim_en: Colorado applications, with a VA Benefit Summary Letter attached, go to the county tax assessor's office between January 1 and July 1.
facts.claim_es: En Colorado, la solicitud con la carta de resumen de beneficios del VA se entrega en la oficina del tasador del condado entre el 1 de enero y el 1 de julio.
facts.source_name: Colorado Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
facts.quote: Applications with an attached VA Benefit Summary Letter must be submitted to the county tax assessor’s office between January 1 and July 1.

facts.claim_en: In Georgia, veterans file an Application for Homestead Exemption with their county tax officials.
facts.claim_es: En Georgia, los veteranos presentan una solicitud de exención de vivienda principal ante las autoridades fiscales de su condado.
facts.quote: Veterans will need to file an Application for Homestead Exemption

facts.claim_en: To qualify in Georgia, the disabled veteran must own the home and use it as a primary residence.
facts.claim_es: Para calificar en Georgia, el veterano discapacitado debe ser dueño de la vivienda y usarla como residencia principal.
facts.quote: In order to qualify, the disabled veteran must own the home and use it as a primary residence.

facts.claim_en: Georgia extends the exemption to an un-remarried surviving spouse or minor children while they keep living in the home.
facts.claim_es: Georgia extiende la exención al cónyuge sobreviviente que no se haya vuelto a casar o a los hijos menores mientras sigan viviendo en la vivienda.
facts.quote: This exemption is extended to the un-remarried surviving spouse or minor children as long as they continue to occupy the home as a residence.

facts.claim_en: Georgia's tax exemptions are administered as interpreted by the tax commissioners of its 159 counties.
facts.claim_es: Las exenciones fiscales de Georgia se administran según la interpretación de los comisionados fiscales de sus 159 condados.
facts.quote: The administration of tax exemptions is as interpreted by the tax commissioners of Georgia’s 159 counties.

facts.claim_en: Iowa's military property tax exemption lowers the assessed value of a veteran's home by up to $4,000.
facts.claim_es: La exención militar de Iowa reduce el valor tasado de la vivienda de un veterano hasta $4,000 para efectos del impuesto a la propiedad.
facts.quote: This benefit drops the assessed value of a veteran's home for property tax purposes up to $4,000.

facts.claim_en: Iowa's Department of Veterans Affairs says to ask your County Assessor and veterans service officer about your property.
facts.claim_es: El Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos de Iowa recomienda consultar sobre su propiedad con el tasador del condado y el oficial de servicio para veteranos.
facts.quote: Ask your County Assessor and VSO about your property and limitations.

facts.claim_en: Iowa's disabled veteran homestead tax credit gives a 100% property tax exemption to veterans rated 100% permanent and total service-connected, or to DIC recipients.
facts.claim_es: El crédito de vivienda para veteranos discapacitados de Iowa da una exención del 100% del impuesto a la propiedad a veteranos con discapacidad del 100% permanente y total relacionada con el servicio, o a quienes reciben DIC.
facts.quote: Disabled veteran homestead tax credit - provides 100% exemption of property taxes; must be 100% “permanent and total” service-connected disabled or in receipt of DIC.

official_links.label_en: Iowa Department of Veterans Affairs (official site)
official_links.label_es: Iowa Department of Veterans Affairs (sitio oficial)

facts.claim_en: For Illinois's Standard Homestead Exemption for Veterans with Disabilities, the amount depends on the percentage of service-connected disability certified by VA.
facts.claim_es: En la exención estándar de vivienda para veteranos con discapacidad de Illinois, el monto depende del porcentaje de discapacidad relacionada con el servicio certificado por el VA.
facts.quote: The amount of the exemption depends on the percentage of the service-connected disability as certified by the United States Department of Veterans' Affairs.

facts.claim_en: Illinois notes that an exemption for veterans with disabilities is also available on a mobile home owned and used exclusively by the veteran or spouse.
facts.claim_es: Illinois señala que una exención para veteranos con discapacidad también se aplica a una casa móvil que el veterano o su cónyuge posea y use exclusivamente.
facts.quote: This exemption is also available on a mobile home owned and used exclusively by a veteran with a disability or his or her spouse.

facts.claim_en: Illinois says its exemption for specially adapted housing stays valid as long as the veteran, spouse or unmarried surviving spouse lives on the property.
facts.claim_es: Illinois indica que su exención para viviendas adaptadas sigue vigente mientras el veterano, su cónyuge o el cónyuge sobreviviente no casado viva en la propiedad.
facts.quote: The exemption is valid for as long as the veteran, the spouse, or the unmarried surviving spouse resides on the property.

facts.claim_en: In Indiana, for a veteran rated at 50%, the deduction equals 50% of the assessed value.
facts.claim_es: En Indiana, para un veterano con calificación del 50%, la deducción equivale al 50% del valor tasado.
facts.quote: Veteran rated at 50%, deduction is equal to 50% of the assessed value.

facts.claim_en: For a veteran rated at 90%, Indiana's deduction equals 90% of the assessed value.
facts.claim_es: Para un veterano con calificación del 90%, la deducción de Indiana equivale al 90% del valor tasado.
facts.quote: Veteran rated at 90%, deduction is equal to 90% of the assessed value.

facts.claim_en: Indiana allows some veterans to have 100% of the assessed value of their principal residence deducted, if they meet the listed conditions.
facts.claim_es: Indiana permite a algunos veteranos deducir el 100% del valor tasado de su residencia principal si cumplen las condiciones indicadas.
facts.quote: An individual may have 100% of the assessed value deducted from their principal place of residence if they:

facts.claim_en: Indiana lists a $350 disabled veteran property tax credit amount for individuals who meet its conditions.
facts.claim_es: Indiana indica un crédito de $350 en el impuesto a la propiedad para veteranos discapacitados que cumplan sus condiciones.
facts.quote: Disabled Veteran Property Tax Credit Amounts $350 may be applied if the individual:

facts.claim_en: In Maryland, local property tax exemptions are regulated at the county level.
facts.claim_es: En Maryland, las exenciones locales del impuesto a la propiedad se regulan a nivel de condado.
facts.quote: Local property tax exemptions are regulated at the county level.

facts.claim_en: Maryland's veterans department says to call your local Maryland assessment office to learn about eligibility.
facts.claim_es: El departamento de veteranos de Maryland indica que llame a su oficina local de tasación para conocer los requisitos.
facts.quote: To learn more about eligibility, call your local Maryland assessment office.

facts.claim_en: Some active-duty service members in Maryland are eligible for a property tax exemption based on a disability recognized by their branch of service.
facts.claim_es: Algunos miembros en servicio activo en Maryland pueden recibir una exención del impuesto a la propiedad por una discapacidad reconocida por su rama de servicio.
facts.quote: Some active duty service members are eligible for a property tax exemption based on disability recognized by their individual branch of service.

facts.claim_en: Michigan's Disabled Veteran Homestead Property Tax Exemption offers a total property tax exemption on a primary residence owned and occupied by an eligible disabled veteran or surviving spouse.
facts.claim_es: La exención de Míchigan para la vivienda de veteranos discapacitados exime totalmente del impuesto a la propiedad la residencia principal de un veterano discapacitado elegible o su cónyuge sobreviviente.
facts.quote: Michigan Disabled Veteran Homestead Property Tax Exemption offers a total property tax exemption of the primary residence that is owned and occupied by an eligible disabled veterans or their surviving spouse.

facts.claim_en: In Michigan, 100 percent permanently and totally disabled veterans, veterans paid at the 100 percent rate, or un-remarried surviving spouses may request a property tax waiver.
facts.claim_es: En Míchigan, los veteranos con discapacidad del 100% permanente y total, los que reciben beneficios a la tasa del 100% o los cónyuges sobrevivientes que no se han vuelto a casar pueden pedir una exención del impuesto a la propiedad.
facts.quote: 100 percent permanently and totally disabled veterans, veterans who are entitled to veterans benefits at the 100 percent rate or un-remarried surviving spouses may request a property tax waiver

facts.claim_en: Michigan's income tax code provides a credit for property tax paid by a disabled veteran or surviving spouse.
facts.claim_es: El código del impuesto sobre la renta de Míchigan ofrece un crédito por el impuesto a la propiedad pagado por un veterano discapacitado o su cónyuge sobreviviente.
facts.quote: The state's income tax code provides a tax credit for property tax paid by a disabled veteran or surviving spouse.

official_links.label_es: Michigan Veterans Affairs Agency (sitio oficial)

facts.claim_en: North Carolina's disabled veteran homestead exemption covers the first $45,000 of your assessed real property value.
facts.claim_es: La exención de vivienda para veteranos discapacitados de Carolina del Norte cubre los primeros $45,000 del valor tasado de su propiedad.
facts.source_name: North Carolina Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
facts.quote: The disabled veteran homestead exemption is the first $45,000 of your assessed real property value.

facts.claim_en: Once certified, North Carolina veterans submit Form NCDVA-9 and Form AV-9 to their local county tax office.
facts.claim_es: Una vez certificados, los veteranos de Carolina del Norte presentan los formularios NCDVA-9 y AV-9 en la oficina fiscal de su condado.
facts.source_name: North Carolina Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
facts.quote: Once certified, submit Form NCDVA-9 and Form AV-9 Application for Property Tax Relief to your local county tax office.

facts.claim_en: North Carolina recommends submitting Form NCDVA-9 for certification well in advance of June 1.
facts.claim_es: Carolina del Norte recomienda presentar el formulario NCDVA-9 para certificación con bastante anticipación al 1 de junio.
facts.source_name: North Carolina Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
facts.quote: We recommend that you submit Form NCDVA-9 to the State Veterans Service Center or County Veterans Service Office well in advance of June 1

official_links.label_es: North Carolina Department of Military and Veterans Affairs (sitio oficial)

facts.claim_en: In North Dakota, if two disabled veterans are married and live together, their combined credits may not exceed 100% or $9,000 of the homestead's taxable value.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Norte, si dos veteranos discapacitados están casados y viven juntos, sus créditos combinados no pueden superar el 100% o $9,000 del valor imponible de la vivienda.
facts.source_name: North Dakota Department of Veterans Affairs
facts.quote: If two disabled veterans are married and living together, the combined credits may not exceed 100% or $9,000 of taxable value of the homestead.

facts.claim_en: North Dakota's Disabled Veteran's Property Tax Credit application is due by April 1 of the year the property is assessed.
facts.claim_es: La solicitud del crédito de Dakota del Norte vence el 1 de abril del año en que se tasa la propiedad.
facts.source_name: North Dakota Department of Veterans Affairs
facts.quote: The application is due by April 1st of the year in which the property is assessed and for which the credit is requested.

facts.claim_en: In North Dakota, the application goes to the local assessor or county director of tax equalization.
facts.claim_es: En Dakota del Norte, la solicitud se entrega al tasador local o al director de igualación fiscal del condado.
facts.source_name: North Dakota Department of Veterans Affairs
facts.quote: Application for Disabled Veterans Property Tax Credit to the local assessor or county director of tax equalization

official_links.label_es: North Dakota Department of Veterans Affairs (sitio oficial)

facts.claim_en: New York has four different property tax exemptions available to veterans or certain family members.
facts.claim_es: Nueva York tiene cuatro exenciones distintas del impuesto a la propiedad para veteranos o ciertos familiares.
facts.source_name: New York State Department of Veterans’ Services
facts.quote: There are four different property tax exemptions available to veterans (or certain members of their family)

facts.claim_en: In New York, getting a veterans exemption is not automatic: an eligible veteran submits the initial application to the assessor.
facts.claim_es: En Nueva York, la exención para veteranos no es automática: el veterano elegible presenta la solicitud inicial ante el tasador.
facts.source_name: New York State Department of Veterans’ Services
facts.quote: Obtaining a veterans exemption is not automatic

facts.claim_en: New York's tax department says to ask your assessor or municipal clerk which veterans exemptions are available for your property.
facts.claim_es: El departamento de impuestos de Nueva York recomienda preguntar al tasador o al secretario municipal qué exenciones para veteranos aplican a su propiedad.
facts.source_name: New York State Department of Veterans’ Services
facts.quote: Ask your assessor or municipal clerk if any of these veterans exemptions are available for your property.

facts.claim_en: In New York, counties, cities, towns, villages and school districts can choose whether to offer the alternative veterans exemption.
facts.claim_es: En Nueva York, los condados, ciudades, pueblos, aldeas y distritos escolares pueden decidir si ofrecen la exención alternativa para veteranos.
facts.source_name: New York State Department of Veterans’ Services
facts.quote: Counties, cities, towns, villages, and school districts have the option to offer this exemption to qualified veterans.

official_links.label_es: New York State Department of Veterans’ Services (sitio oficial)

facts.claim_en: Disabled veterans in Oregon may qualify to borrow from the state to pay property taxes to the county (a deferral).
facts.claim_es: Los veteranos discapacitados en Oregón pueden calificar para un préstamo del estado que paga el impuesto a la propiedad al condado (aplazamiento).
facts.quote: Disabled veterans may qualify to "borrow" from the State of Oregon to pay property taxes to the county.

facts.claim_en: In Oregon, applicants file with their local county assessor's office.
facts.claim_es: En Oregón, los solicitantes presentan su solicitud en la oficina del tasador de su condado.
facts.quote: Applicants must file their requests with their local county assessor’s office.

facts.claim_en: Oregon's property tax exemptions also apply to qualifying surviving spouses of veterans.
facts.claim_es: Las exenciones del impuesto a la propiedad de Oregón también se aplican a cónyuges sobrevivientes de veteranos que califiquen.
facts.quote: Property tax exemptions also apply to qualifying surviving spouses of veterans.

facts.claim_en: In South Carolina, a veteran totally and permanently disabled from a service-connected disability may apply for a property tax exemption on two private passenger vehicles they own or lease.
facts.claim_es: En Carolina del Sur, un veterano con discapacidad total y permanente relacionada con el servicio puede pedir una exención del impuesto a la propiedad para dos vehículos de pasajeros que posea o arriende.
facts.source_name: South Carolina Department of Veterans’ Affairs
facts.quote: A veteran who is totally and permanently disabled from a service-connected disability may apply for a Property Tax exemption for two private passenger vehicles they own or lease.

facts.claim_en: In South Carolina, to be exempt for the current year you must be the owner of record and your disability's effective date must be on or before December 31 of the previous year.
facts.claim_es: En Carolina del Sur, para quedar exento en el año actual debe ser el propietario registrado y la fecha efectiva de su discapacidad debe ser el 31 de diciembre del año anterior o antes.
facts.source_name: South Carolina Department of Veterans’ Affairs
facts.quote: to be exempt for the current year, you must be the owner of record and your effective date of disability must be on or before December 31 of the previous year.

facts.claim_en: The South Carolina Department of Revenue decides whether property qualifies for the exemptions in SC Code Section 12-37-220.
facts.claim_es: El Departamento de Ingresos de Carolina del Sur decide si una propiedad califica para las exenciones de la Sección 12-37-220 del Código de Carolina del Sur.
facts.source_name: South Carolina Department of Veterans’ Affairs
facts.quote: The SCDOR determines if any property (real or personal) qualifies for exemption from ad valorem taxes that are found in SC Code Section 12-37-220 .

facts.claim_en: In Texas, the disabled veteran exemption can be applied to any one property the disabled veteran owns, unlike the disabled person exemption, which applies only to a residence homestead.
facts.claim_es: En Texas, la exención para veteranos discapacitados puede aplicarse a cualquier propiedad del veterano, a diferencia de la exención para personas con discapacidad, que solo se aplica a la vivienda principal.
facts.quote: Unlike the disabled person exemption, which only applies to residence homestead property, the disabled veteran exemption can be applied to any one property the disabled veteran owns.

facts.claim_en: In Texas, an unmarried surviving spouse or surviving children under 18 of a disabled veteran may also qualify for a partial exemption.
facts.claim_es: En Texas, el cónyuge sobreviviente no casado o los hijos sobrevivientes menores de 18 años de un veterano discapacitado también pueden calificar para una exención parcial.
facts.quote: The surviving spouse (if unmarried) or surviving children (if under age 18) of a disabled veteran may also qualify to receive a partial exemption.

facts.claim_en: The Texas exemption amount depends on the veteran's disability rating.
facts.claim_es: El monto de la exención en Texas depende de la calificación de discapacidad del veterano.
facts.quote: The exemption amount depends on the veteran's disability rating from the U.S.

official_links.label_es: Texas Veterans Commission (sitio oficial)

facts.claim_en: In Vermont, veterans with a 50% or greater service-connected disability, or receiving Improved Pension, are eligible for a property tax reduction.
facts.claim_es: En Vermont, los veteranos con una discapacidad relacionada con el servicio del 50% o más, o que reciben la Pensión Mejorada, pueden recibir una reducción del impuesto a la propiedad.
facts.quote: Veterans with 50% or greater service-connected disability or who are receiving Improved Pension are eligible for a property tax reduction.

facts.claim_en: Vermont's exemption reduces the appraised value of the home before taxes are assessed.
facts.claim_es: La exención de Vermont reduce el valor tasado de la vivienda antes de calcular los impuestos.
facts.quote: The exemption reduces the appraised value of the home prior to the assessment of taxes.

facts.claim_en: Vermont's exemption applies only to a primary residence owned by the veteran or survivor.
facts.claim_es: La exención de Vermont solo se aplica a la residencia principal que sea propiedad del veterano o sobreviviente.
facts.quote: The exemption only applies to homes that are owned by the veteran or survivor; and is the primary residence.

official_links.label_en: Vermont Office of Veterans Affairs (official site)
official_links.label_es: Vermont Office of Veterans Affairs (sitio oficial)

facts.claim_en: In Washington, income-based property tax exemptions and deferrals may be available to veterans compensated at the 80% service-connected rate, as well as seniors and people retired due to disability.
facts.claim_es: En Washington, puede haber exenciones y aplazamientos del impuesto a la propiedad según ingresos para veteranos compensados a la tasa del 80%, personas mayores y jubilados por discapacidad.
facts.quote: Income based property tax exemptions and deferrals may be available to seniors, those retired due to disability and veterans compensated at the 80% service connected rate.

facts.claim_en: Washington's Department of Veterans Affairs says to contact your County Assessor for more information.
facts.claim_es: El Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos de Washington recomienda comunicarse con el tasador de su condado.
facts.quote: Contact your County Assessor for more information.

facts.claim_en: Washington's guidance notes VA disability compensation is not counted toward disposable income for this property tax relief.
facts.claim_es: La guía de Washington indica que la compensación por discapacidad del VA no cuenta como ingreso disponible para este alivio fiscal.
facts.quote: VA Disability is still not counted toward disposable income

facts.claim_en: Wisconsin's Veterans and Surviving Spouses Property Tax Credit covers 100% of property taxes paid on a primary residence, including up to one acre of land.
facts.claim_es: El crédito fiscal de Wisconsin para veteranos y cónyuges sobrevivientes cubre el 100% del impuesto a la propiedad pagado sobre la residencia principal, incluido hasta un acre de terreno.
facts.quote: The credit covers 100% of property taxes paid on a primary residence (including land up to one acre).

facts.claim_en: Wisconsin's credit cannot be applied to second homes or vacation properties.
facts.claim_es: El crédito de Wisconsin no se aplica a segundas viviendas ni a propiedades vacacionales.
facts.quote: The credit cannot be applied to second homes or vacation properties.

facts.claim_en: In Wisconsin, if you pay property taxes as part of your rent, you may qualify but must provide proof.
facts.claim_es: En Wisconsin, si paga el impuesto a la propiedad como parte de su renta, puede calificar, pero debe presentar comprobantes.
facts.quote: If you pay property taxes as part of your rent, you may qualify but must provide proof.

facts.claim_en: In West Virginia, veterans rated 90-100 percent permanent and disabled by VA may be exempt from certain property taxes.
facts.claim_es: En Virginia Occidental, los veteranos con calificación del VA de 90 a 100 por ciento permanente pueden quedar exentos de ciertos impuestos a la propiedad.
facts.source_name: West Virginia Department of Veterans Assistance
facts.quote: Veterans rated 90-100 percent permanent and disabled by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) may be exempt from certain property taxes.

facts.claim_en: West Virginia lists a tax credit that honorably discharged disabled veteran homeowners from any branch can claim.
facts.claim_es: Virginia Occidental ofrece un crédito fiscal que pueden reclamar los veteranos discapacitados propietarios de vivienda con baja honorable de cualquier rama.
facts.source_name: West Virginia Department of Veterans Assistance
facts.quote: This tax credit can be claimed by honorably discharged Disabled Veteran homeowners from any branch of the U.S.

facts.claim_en: West Virginia veterans who think they qualify should contact their County Assessor's Office or local Benefit Office.
facts.claim_es: Los veteranos de Virginia Occidental que crean calificar deben comunicarse con la oficina del tasador de su condado o su oficina local de beneficios.
facts.source_name: West Virginia Department of Veterans Assistance
facts.quote: Veterans who believe they qualify should contact their County Assessors' Office or their local Benefit Office

official_links.label_es: West Virginia Department of Veterans Assistance (sitio oficial)

facts.claim_en: Wyoming veterans must be residents for three or more years before claiming the tax exemption and must have a DD Form 214 or equivalent.
facts.claim_es: En Wyoming, los veteranos deben haber residido tres años o más antes de pedir la exención y tener el formulario DD 214 o equivalente.
facts.quote: Veterans must be residents of Wyoming three or more years prior to claiming the tax exemption and must have a DD Form 214 or equivalent.

facts.claim_en: In Wyoming, apply for the veterans property tax exemption at your County Assessor's Office between January 1 and the fourth Monday of May each year.
facts.claim_es: En Wyoming, la exención del impuesto a la propiedad para veteranos se solicita en la oficina del tasador del condado entre el 1 de enero y el cuarto lunes de mayo de cada año.
facts.quote: Apply at your County Assessor’s Office between January 1 and the fourth Monday of May each year.

facts.claim_en: Wyoming provides a tax exemption to veterans for vehicles and property.
facts.claim_es: Wyoming ofrece a los veteranos una exención fiscal para vehículos y propiedades.
facts.quote: Wyoming provides a tax exemption to veterans for vehicles and property.
